outputs.L2: This disclosure describes a recirculation device having a body that includes one or more first channels arranged to admit exhaust, one or more second channels arranged to admit fuel, and one or more third channels arranged to carry a combined stream of the exhaust and fuel. The body also defines a longitudinal axis running from the second channel toward the third channel. The device may further include a nozzle with an internal chamber that guides fuel toward an opening positioned at the location where the internal chamber has its minimum cross-sectional area. A piston is slidably disposed in the body and has a first end arranged to receive fuel and a second end arranged to deliver fuel into the nozzle chamber. Exhaust can move the piston along the body’s longitudinal axis, thereby regulating the amount of fuel flowing through the opening. A mixing chamber positioned inside the body may be arranged to receive exhaust and to receive fuel discharged from the opening.
outputs.L3:
The disclosure relates to a recirculation device having a body that defines multiple internal passages for directing different fluid flows. In particular, the body includes an exhaust passage configured to receive or convey exhaust, a fuel passage configured to receive fuel, and a mixture passage configured to convey a mixture of exhaust and fuel after the two streams have been combined.

The device is arranged about a longitudinal axis that extends generally from the fuel passage toward the mixture passage. This axis provides a reference direction for the flow of fuel and for the movement of certain internal components within the body.

A nozzle is positioned within the device and includes an inner cavity through which fuel may pass. The inner cavity is shaped to direct the fuel toward an orifice. The orifice is located at the region of the cavity having the smallest cross-sectional area, thereby defining a restricted opening through which the fuel can be discharged.

The device also includes a piston that is slideably received within the body. The piston is configured to move along the longitudinal axis and is actuated by exhaust flowing or applied within the device. Movement of the piston may therefore be controlled by exhaust pressure or exhaust flow acting on the piston.

The piston regulates the passage of fuel through the orifice and into a mixing chamber. The mixing chamber is arranged to receive both exhaust from the exhaust passage and fuel discharged through the orifice. In this way, the piston controls the amount or timing of fuel introduced into the chamber, where the fuel combines with exhaust before being directed through the mixture passage.
outputs.L4:
A recirculation device is provided for mixing exhaust gas with fuel in a controlled manner. The device includes a body defining one or more exhaust passages, a fuel passage, a mixing chamber, and a nozzle arranged to deliver fuel toward the mixing chamber. Exhaust gas is directed through the exhaust passages into the mixing chamber, while fuel is supplied through the fuel passage and selectively metered through an orifice associated with the nozzle.

The device further includes a piston positioned for movement along a longitudinal axis. The piston is exposed to exhaust pressure so that changes in exhaust flow or exhaust pressure cause the piston to shift axially within the device. Movement of the piston regulates the flow of fuel through the orifice, thereby controlling the amount of fuel introduced into the exhaust-fed mixing chamber. In this way, fuel delivery is responsive to operating conditions within the exhaust stream.

During operation, exhaust gas enters the device and acts on the piston. As exhaust pressure increases or decreases, the piston moves correspondingly along the longitudinal axis. This movement changes the effective opening of the fuel orifice, increasing, decreasing, or otherwise modulating the quantity of fuel discharged through the nozzle. The discharged fuel is then mixed with the exhaust gas within the mixing chamber, producing an exhaust-fuel mixture suitable for recirculation or further downstream processing.

By using exhaust pressure to actuate the piston, the device provides a mechanically responsive fuel-metering arrangement that can improve mixture formation without requiring complex external control components. The configuration allows fuel to be introduced in proportion to exhaust conditions, promoting more consistent blending and improved management of exhaust-fuel recirculation. The passages, nozzle, piston, and orifice cooperate to provide controlled delivery of fuel into the exhaust stream, enhancing regulation of the recirculated mixture and supporting efficient operation of the associated engine or exhaust system.
outputs.L5:
**The Power of “The”**

The word **“the”** may be small, but it is one of the most important words in the English language. It is called a definite article, and it helps us talk about something specific. For example, when we say “a book,” we could mean any book. But when we say “the book,” we are talking about one particular book that the speaker and listener both understand.

“The” gives clarity and direction to a sentence. It points to a person, place, object, or idea that is already known or unique. We say “the sun” because there is only one sun in our sky, and we say “the door” when we mean a specific door in a room.

Although it is short, “the” appears everywhere in English. It connects ideas, makes speech more precise, and helps people understand meaning more easily. Without “the,” many sentences would sound incomplete or confusing. This simple word shows that even the smallest parts of language can have a powerful role.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for an exhaust gas recirculation device that mixes exhaust with fuel using a piston-actuated nozzle and internal passages.
counterfactuals.output: An exhaust gas recirculation device is provided for mixing recirculated exhaust gas with fuel prior to delivery to an engine intake or combustion system. The device includes a housing defining an exhaust gas passage, a fuel passage, and a mixing chamber in fluid communication with an outlet. A piston is movably disposed within the housing and is operatively coupled to a nozzle arranged to discharge fuel into the mixing chamber. Movement of the piston selectively varies an opening of the nozzle and regulates communication between the internal passages, thereby controlling the quantity, timing, and dispersion of fuel introduced into the exhaust gas stream. Recirculated exhaust gas flowing through the exhaust gas passage entrains and mixes with fuel discharged from the piston-actuated nozzle to form a blended exhaust-fuel mixture. The internal passages may be configured to promote turbulence, atomization, and uniform distribution of the fuel within the exhaust gas. The device enables improved mixing and controlled recirculation for enhanced combustion efficiency and emissions reduction.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a "present disclosure provides..." paragraph describing a recirculation device with a body, exhaust passage, fuel passage, mixture passage, nozzle orifice, sliding piston, and mixing chamber.
counterfactuals.output: The present disclosure provides a recirculation device including a body defining an exhaust passage configured to receive a flow of exhaust gas, a fuel passage configured to receive a flow of fuel, and a mixture passage configured to discharge a fuel-exhaust mixture. The body further defines a mixing chamber in fluid communication with the exhaust passage, the fuel passage, and the mixture passage, and a nozzle orifice arranged to introduce the fuel into the mixing chamber. A sliding piston is movably disposed within the body and is configured to translate between positions to selectively vary fluid communication through at least one of the exhaust passage, the fuel passage, the nozzle orifice, the mixing chamber, and the mixture passage. In operation, exhaust gas and fuel are directed into the mixing chamber, where the fuel introduced through the nozzle orifice mixes with the exhaust gas, and the resulting mixture is delivered through the mixture passage for recirculation.

counterfactuals.prompt: Provide a broad patent disclosure paragraph for an engine recirculation device that receives exhaust and fuel, directs fuel through a nozzle, and uses a piston within the body to regulate fuel flow into a mixing chamber.
counterfactuals.output: In some embodiments, an engine recirculation device includes a body defining an exhaust inlet configured to receive exhaust gas from an engine, a fuel inlet configured to receive fuel, and a mixing chamber in fluid communication with the exhaust inlet. A fuel passage extends through the body from the fuel inlet to a nozzle arranged to discharge fuel into the mixing chamber for combination with the received exhaust gas. A piston is movably disposed within a bore of the body and is positioned to selectively regulate communication between the fuel passage, the nozzle, and/or the mixing chamber. Movement of the piston may vary an effective flow area, pressure, timing, or amount of fuel delivered through the nozzle, thereby controlling fuel introduction into the exhaust stream. The piston may be actuated by fuel pressure, exhaust pressure, spring bias, mechanical linkage, electromagnetic force, pneumatic or hydraulic pressure, or an electronic controller, and may be configured to open, close, meter, pulse, or otherwise modulate fuel flow in response to one or more engine operating conditions. The resulting exhaust-fuel mixture may be routed downstream for recirculation, combustion enhancement, emissions control, thermal management, or other engine-system functions.
